clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Brine gives an empty waterskin to a shaman initiate.

Brine gives a shaman initiate an empty leather skin for the opening trial of the Call of Water. The initiate must carry it to the watering hole beneath her dwelling and return with it full. The pool is guarded by local quilboar, who prize its water. In the Barrens, where water is scarce, even a small oasis can sustain life and spark violence.
